reviews.text:
You truly get your money's worth with Connor Training! We spent about two months researching trainers, and no one came close to the value and level of service they offered.
We have a stubborn high-drive Belgian Malinois, and the growth we've seen in him since his board-and-train program has been incredible. The facility is spotless, organized, and professionally run, which immediately gave us peace of mind.
Choosing who to board and train your dog with can be overwhelming, but Albert and his team made the entire process stress-free. They took amazing care of our pup and were always available to answer our questions before, during, and even after the program.
One of our favorite parts was that we were included in the training sessions. They don't just train your dog—they train you too! So you have the knowledge and confidence to continue the work at home. That level of support made all the difference.
We couldn't be happier with our experience and highly recommend Connor Training to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely caring team to help bring out the best in their dog. Thank you Connor Training!!!

If you’re looking for a trainer who truly transforms dogs not just teaches commands Connor Canine Training is the place to go.

Before coming here, I had taken my Belgian Malinois, Oakley, to another trainer when he was younger. Unfortunately, he came home lacking confidence, wasn’t listening, and seemed scared of almost everything.

A few months later, I decided to give Connor Canine Training a chance, and I’m so glad I did. Albert worked with Oakley for about four weeks, and the transformation has been incredible. He not only taught Oakley all of his commands, but he also helped build his confidence. The difference is night and day.

Oakley is much calmer, no longer timid or fearful, and is significantly more confident around people and in new environments. He listens exceptionally well and has become a much more balanced dog. The training didn’t just teach obedience it completely changed his mindset.

What really stood out was that Albert also spent time training me before Oakley came home. He made sure I understood how to properly handle and communicate with my dog so we could continue building on everything Oakley had learned. That made a huge difference.

I couldn’t be happier with the experience and the results. If you’re looking for a trainer who genuinely cares about your dog and delivers outstanding results, I highly recommend Albert at Connor Canine Training. I would recommend him without hesitation, and I only wish I had chosen him from the very beginning.
Couldn’t be any happier with the training
Albert and his team were absolutely awesome. If there were such a thing as dog Psychology, he’d have a PHD!

Albert was extremely professional and patient throughout Rocky’s board and train. He kept in touch the entire time with updates and made us feel very comfortable leaving Rocky with him. When it was time for me to start training with Rocky before he came home, Albert was very helpful and patient in teaching me everything I needed to know. I highly recommend Albert to anyone looking for a great trainer and team.

Albert and his team of trainers reshaped my families experience with our new dog. Basic obedience is the foundation of a positive dog ownership experience. Being able to place your dog, recall them, and keep focus is invaluable. Our dog is not just better all around, she’s manageable for a hyper breed. We even took time with my son to help him understand the basics. Worth every penny for the peace it’s brought to my home.

Albert absolutely knocked it out of the park! His amazing passion, knowledge, and patience transformed our crazy puppy into a dog you can take anywhere.

He teaches you exceptional communication skills & how to continue the training journey. 5 stars isn’t enough 🚀

Albert is absolutely the best! The knowledge that he brings of dogs but especially breeds that would scare others away changed our lives. We are now able to do all the things with our dog that we dreamed of and didn’t think were possible. Connor’s Canine training is a gem and we couldn’t imagine working with anyone else.

I want to sincerely thank the team for the outstanding job they did training my dog. From day one, they showed professionalism, deep knowledge, and a true passion for dogs. My dog didn’t just learn basic obedience — his behavior, focus, and confidence improved tremendously.

They kept me informed throughout the entire process, explaining how to continue the training at home and making sure I also learned how to properly communicate with my dog. The difference before and after the training is incredible.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for serious, effective, and respectful dog training. It was truly one of the best decisions I could have made. Thank you so much for everything!

My experience has been nothing but amazing with Connor Canine Training. From the moment I spoke with Albert I knew that he was the right person to train my puppy Milo.

Albert, his family and team did an exceptional job with Milo. They took time, dedication, love and patience with him. He did boarding training for a month and felt really long but I was receiving updates on a weekly basis. Once we started training together I was so proud of him and the progress he had made. Thank you again for the amazing work! I highly recommend him to every puppy owner.

We had an amazing experience with this dog trainer and his facility. From day one, he was incredibly professional, patient, and knowledgeable. The place is clean, welcoming, and feels like a second home for the doggies.
Most importantly, Samson absolutely loves him and his family. You can truly see the care, love, and dedication they put into every dog they work with. Samson was always excited to be there, which gave us so much peace of mind. The training results were great, but what really stood out was the bond and trust they built with him.
I highly recommend this trainer to anyone looking for a safe, loving, and effective environment for their dog. We are beyond grateful for everything they’ve done for Samson ❤️🐾

I cannot recommend this Albert enough. I have an Australian Shepherd — a very high-energy, driven breed that absolutely needs the right structure and guidance — and the transformation has been incredible.

My dog didn’t just learn commands. He came back calmer, more focused, more balanced, and clearly more confident. It truly feels like I got the best version of him back. That kind of change takes real knowledge, consistency, patience, and genuine passion, and it’s obvious this trainer has all of that and more.

Beyond the training itself, the level of care was exceptional. My dog came home clean, healthy, and looking fantastic. It gave me so much peace of mind knowing he was being treated with such attention and care, not just worked with.

I highly recommend Albert and his team of passionate dog trainers.

I trusted Conner canine training with my dog Bruno to help give him the foundation he needed And I’m very glad to say I got back that and more. During the board I would get updates with videos and pictures of Bruno and I had 24/7 access to the trainers. I’m glad to say Bruno came back healthy happy and with a great foundation. I would definitely recommend this family owned business to any of my freinds and family !!!! Thank you guys so much

I contacted Albert about Logan because of her fear agression and lack of socialization. I was at a point where I thought nothing could help. Albert and his team welcomed Logan with open arms, patience, dedication and love. The change I’ve seen in my dog has been mind blowing and life moving forward will be completely different for myself and Logan all thanks to Connor Canine Training. I can’t recommend Albert and his team enough!
the beat training for my baby!!!

Huge shoutout to Connor Canine Training Facility for doing such an awesome job with our Malinois, Sobe. She’s listening so much better, following commands, and getting along great with our other two Belgian Malinois both at work and outside. We’re really grateful for the time and effort they put into her. She’s come a long way, and we couldn’t be happier with her progress! Big big thank you to your team!

Albert and his team have been amazing with our Stella (Cane Corso). This breed is definitely one that needs basic training as they are so strong when they grow up. Albert’s family loved our Stella and treated her amazing. The training was 🤌🏽 . When the four weeks had passed, he said we should leave her for another two weeks bc he didn’t think she was ready- this is a true sign of a business owner who truly cares and is passionate about what he does!! Hands down highly recommend (actually we have multiple times!)

I can’t say enough great things about Connor Canine Training Facility! My two Belgian Malinois learned so much during their month of training. They came home happy, confident, and eager to show off all their new skills. We were so impressed that we board them there whenever we go on vacation. Albert their trainer is incredible, kind, patient, and extremely skilled. My dogs get so excited every time they see him! I wouldn’t trust anyone else but the Connor Canine Training team to care for them.

Albert did a great job with my fur babies. He trained our Goldendoodle, who was a wild puppy and he got her to listen. We’re able to take her on outings with us and she listens. He also trained our Yorkie who had aggression issues. Albert did an amazing job! Thank you so much!
Amazing trainers!! Trustworthy and knowledgeable! Great at training owners how dogs think and what needs to be done to continue training at home!

I took my Damon for a boarding with Connor canine training bc he was having aggression problems after he got attacked by my neighbors dog and  had many behavioral issues since he is almost 2 year old European Doberman that weighs 80lb and after he got attacked he would not listen to be AT ALL!!  So I took the best decision that I could have made to take him to Albert . I have all good things to say !! They way that his family treats my Damon and loves on him even tho sometimes he can be a bit much was so welcoming and sweet. The time and dedication that is put in with the training really showed when I had just left him there for 1 week they had taught him things that I would take months to teach him. I also love the way that it’s not only ur dog getting trained but also I got trained in every session and everything was explained to be with patients. Over all I couldn’t be more happy with the results of Damon and i wouldn’t trust ANYONE else with my baby. If you are looking to have ur dog trained!? Definitely go with CONNOR CANINE TRAINING! I promise you it’s 100% worth it !

The team at Connor K9 training is Amazing. They make you very comfortable and confident about leaving your pup right of the bat. Boarded my 2 year old pitbull with them and they did an incredible job with his obedience training. Highly recommend

Both of our dogs have improved so much since training, it’s made such a difference. Now we also leave them here for boarding when we go on vacation, and it gives us total peace of mind knowing they’re loved and cared for like family. Highly recommend!
Highly recommend training. Our wild dogs came back and are easy to handle now. We also use the boarding atleast once a month. The dogs love going over for a stay

We had an aggression issue with our Dogo Argentino, so we searched and couldn't find a place we felt comfortable with leaving our large breed dog. We found Connor Canine Training and were extremely satisfied with the end result with choosing the board & training option, which also aloud us to get hands on training towards the end. Not to mention the facility is spacious and super clean. We're super happy how he gets along with his other four siblings. You can visit DOGDAD_OF5 on YouTube too see the results. Thanks again to the team over at Connors.

I had a horrible experience with a different trainer then I went to Albert and let me tell you. He is top notch!!!!! My dog is on point and listens to my commands. If your looking for a trainer don’t look anymore a speak with Albert. I highly recommend him!!!!!

Learning the fundamentals of dog training was a really rewarding experience for me.
I truly enjoyed learning the essential techniques for training my dog.
It was a great experience to understand and apply the basics of dog training.
Went to a class and loved it. He is the best, so much know knowledge, he truly understands every need and goes above and beyond. Would definitely return and recommend everyone I know.

We had an awesome experience with our mini Schnauzer Sage! Albert was very attentive to our needs, he took his time with our stubborn puppy. She truly came back a new dog! We did 5 sessions of training at the facility to ensure that she was truly ready to go home. This reflected true obedience and made the transition home VERY smooth. Thank you Albert & team for taking amazing care of our baby while she trained!

Absolutely amazing! Can not recommend enough! We have a family dog that we needed assistance training because her energy was through the roof. And she came back with the same personality just with the ability to listen to us.
Our pupp was very missed while she was gone in training, but we were sent pictures and updates often putting us at ease.
Everything was thoroughly explained to us so we are able to continue the training process at home and understand why we are doing what we are doing.

We just want to give a HUGE thank you to Albert at Connor Canine Training for all the amazing work with Ash 🐾💛. The progress he’s made is incredible—he’s more focused, better behaved, and honestly just thriving. It’s been so rewarding to see his confidence grow and his sweet personality shine through even more.

Training isn’t always easy, but with your patience, knowledge, and encouragement, Ash has come so far. We’re beyond grateful for the tools you’ve given us and for the positive impact you’ve had on our boy (and on us as his humans too!).

We can’t wait to keep building on everything he’s learned. Thank you again for helping Ash be the best version of himself! 🐶✨
Very professional,  respectful people. Great outdoor and indoor area for training dogs. I had a great experience with Cane Corso I rescued from Miami dade animal shelter.  Highly recommended!

Great job Connor’s , Zuri is so much better, her confidence is through the roof. Zuri is a 15 month old German Shepherd, and highly intelligent, but she had a behavioral flaw that made her insecure and wanting to alienate her self. Spending her time  at Conor’s has made a tremendous difference in her She is truly blossoming now and is no longer in her shell. Albert and the staff showed her much love and positive reinforcement making it a fun experience for her not just the training, they really went the extra mile with her
Thank You , Connors

We took our dog Bruno to Connor Canine Training after he had already went through two trainers for a total of nine sessions. Bruno stayed at Connor for a month and learned so much and gained discipline. The owner Albert not only trains the dogs but also spends so much time with the owners making sure they have all the tools to continue the training once they go home. He has so much patience. The facility is very clean and my dog was always happy and healthy. I wish I found them before I wasted my time and money on all the training we did before we found them.

I want to thank Albert and his staff for everything they did for our GSD puppy. The attention to detail in his training, along with how far our dog’s obedience has come along, really shows the love Albert and his staff have for the dogs they train. Highly recommend for anyone who has a dog they want to put through obedience training! The best in the business!!

I boarded my fluffy guy here while I was out of the country on my honeymoon, and the experience was amazing. I was a bit worried since he can be a little aggressive and had never stayed away from home before—but I couldn’t have been more pleasantly surprised. The team really took the time to make him feel safe and comfortable. By the second day, they sent me a video of him happily playing and being super friendly with them.

It’s clear they truly love dogs and understand that each one has a different personality. They provided personalized care and attention that made all the difference.

My only warning? Don’t leave your dog here for too long—they might not want to come back home with you!

I boarded my Maltipoo, Teddy, here for a week while I was away for my wedding and honeymoon. I was nervous at first, but Albert and his family made me feel completely at ease. They sent me daily photos and videos, and Teddy quickly bonded with Albert’s dad. He had a great time and was well cared for. Highly recommend their boarding services—I'll be back for training soon!

Even though we have the most stubborn breed (Husky), the trainer took her in. Skye has improved so much and is now quite an obedient dog considering the breed. We are very happy with her trainings and would recommend Connor Canine Training to anyone who wants well-behaved pets. Highly recommended!

Incredible Results with Our Australian Shepherd!

Albert is truly a gifted dog trainer. Our Australian Shepherd is smart but high-energy and stubborn—and we were struggling to manage her behavior. After working with Albert, the transformation has been amazing. He not only helped our dog become more focused and obedient, but he also taught us how to better communicate and reinforce good habits.

Albert is professional, patient, and clearly passionate about what he does. His training methods are effective, kind, and tailored to your dog's personality and needs. We appreciated how he explained everything clearly and gave us tools we could continue using long after the sessions ended.

If you're looking for someone who genuinely understands dogs and gets real results, we can't recommend Albert enough. We’re so grateful for the difference he’s made in our home!
100% success! Highly recommend.

Albert was amazing with our two dogs, Toronto and Tofu. They were puppies when they started their training and after Sleep-away training for four weeks Albert turned  them into well-behaved listening dogs. It was easy to work with Albert and his team. They were responsive to scheduling trainings. Most importantly he was fun to work with, and the dogs loved him. Hopefully we won’t have to return for brush up sessions cause we’ll do the work at home. We would highly recommend them as a wonderful place to have your dog trained.

Our Puppy Luna went to Connor K9 Training and she is amazing. So well trained
She is socialized and gets along with our other dog
She follows all the commands she was taught and is learning news ones already

Albert the owner and Trainer is an amazing person and takes time with each dog in his care, but more importantly he trains the human owners which takes a very special kind of person

If you want you dog trained or boarded. This is the person you need

Contact Connor Canine training

The puppy that we dropped off and the puppy that we picked up are two totally different dogs... In the best way possible! Albert and his team had their work cut out with our hyper/ mischievous golden doodle, but they sure exceeded our expectations. Albert was honest about what to expect, in constant communication with us about our dog's progress, and made us feel totally comfortable and safe. He possesses a plethora of knowledge and experience, combined with a true passion for what he does and it shows. Not only was it evident in the night/ day changes of our dog, but it was very clear during our training sessions with him. After a month in training our golden doodle has returned home obedient and able to follow commands. He no longer barks when in his crate and is much easier to handle as he will listen when directed. All in all, this was an investment for our family and the wellbeing of our fur baby. We are truly happy of the work Albert did, and look forward to continuing our dog's training/ utilizing their boarding services.

From the moment we started working together, it was clear that Albert truly cares and has a deep understanding of canine behavior. My dog, Diesel, had issues with basic obedience commands, and within a few sessions, we saw a huge improvement. We just brought him home from his first basic training, and he gave us the tools we need to continue the training at home so that Diesel can continue to improve. Albert was patient, professional, and always positive, and we will definitely be back for an intermediate, more advanced, training for our German Shepherd. All the dogs were kept clean and housed separately to ensure safety and hygiene. Definitely recommend.

I highly recommend Connor Canine Training! Albert & his team were so good with my dog. She was happy every time I saw her. They involved me in her training, kept me updated on her progress & have stayed connected with me even after she came home. My girl, Ruby, listens better, does all her commands & it’s been easy to implement new things with her now. 10/10 experience.

We can’t thank Albert and his amazing family enough for the incredible work they did with our dog, Akai. They trained her to be a service dog for our son during a very difficult time. Akai is now not only well trained, but also deeply connected to our son in a way that brings peace and comfort to our whole family.

From day one, Albert showed patience, professionalism, and genuine love for what he does. He took the time to teach us how to continue Akai’s training at home, and we always felt supported and encouraged to improve with Akai.

We truly believe that God placed Albert and his family in our lives for a reason. The warmth and love they showed us made us feel less like customers and more like family. They welcomed us with open arms, and we will always be grateful for that.

If you’re looking for a dog trainer who is knowledgeable, compassionate, and dedicated you just found him! We highly recommend Albert and his family.
Our experience was nothing short of amazing.

Again THANK YOU!

I can't say enough great things about the experience I had working with Albert for my seven-year-old miniature Australian Shepherd, Finn. Finn is just too smart for his own good, and I wasn’t consistent or disciplined enough in correcting his bad behaviors. He was constantly outsmarting me, and I knew I needed help.

After just five weeks with Albert, the change in Finn has been incredible. I received video and progress updates, and it was clear how much thought and care went into his training. Even more importantly, when it came time to bring Finn home, Albert spent time teaching me how to work with him effectively. That guidance has been invaluable.

The transition home has gone so much smoother than I expected, thanks to his continued responsiveness and support. If you're looking for someone who truly understands dogs, communicates well, and sets both you and your pup up for long-term success, I can’t recommend Albert at Connor Canine Training highly enough.

If you’re looking for a dog trainer, don’t look further and get in contact with Connor Canine Training. At first, I was really sad and nervous that I was leaving my dog with someone new. Albert made sure to get in contact with me multiple times and assure me that my dog was perfectly fine as well as how the training process was going. He made the whole training process really easy! He also shows you how to deliver the commands and explains the importance of training your dog. If he recommends you to go in person so you can get a better idea on how to continue the training at home, don’t think about it twice and go so you can learn how to communicate with your dog.

Albert was an exceptional dog trainer! From the very first session, he was friendly, professional, and made both me and my dog feel comfortable. His communication was excellent, he explained everything clearly and made sure I understood not just the ‘how’ but also the ‘why’ behind the training techniques. He knew and answered all my questions, and lord knows I had a plethora of them. What really stood out was that he didn’t just train my dog; he also trained me as an owner, giving me the confidence and tools to continue reinforcing positive behaviors at home. The results have been incredible, my dog is more obedient, confident, and happy. Total night and day difference. I highly recommend Albert to anyone looking for a skilled, patient, and passionate trainer who truly cares about your dog as if it was his own.

My experience has been nothing but positive. My golden retriever, Levi,  spent 5 weeks here and came back a different dog. Albert, the owner, has success with each dog he’s encountered, from aggressive to skiddish to hyperactive. When I found out that Albert trains K-9s for the police force, I knew Levi would get the training he needs. I’ve been to multiple trainers and I knew the day I dropped off Levi and met Albert, he was going to be in great hands. Albert keeps in touch with you whenever you have any questions and sends you frequent videos of training sessions so you can see how the training progresses. Every video I have of Levi he was wagging his tail and excited to train. Levi is usually afraid of men, but he easily opened up to Albert. Albert’s family treated Levi as one of their own. During the program, every dog is walked multiple times a day so I was rest assured that Levi’s energy needs would be taken care of. Albert also highly encourages you to come after 2 weeks as many times as possible, to learn how to train your dog so you can have a smooth and successful transition when you get home. What you get out of this experience is exactly what you put into it. He is one of the rare trainers that are honest and will tell you what you need to hear to succeed. I truly believe that Albert board and trains for the love of it. If you want a great experience and an obedient dog, this is the best place to be!❤️
Great trainer. Not only he trained Duke but also helped us understand him better and made us a better owner.  Definitely will go the extra mile to help.

Not loosing hope in a well behaved buddy is the biggest act of love towards your furry friend. Albert has been a crucial part of my dog’s new life and along the way bettering mine as well . I took a course on how to better my training so I can practice and reinforce good and desirable behavior. Whichever training you decide to do, you will be really happy with how your dog will come at the end of this. He truly left me with all the tools that are necessary to continue successful training. I truly think that Albert has a passion for what he does and it really shows through the results of all his 4legged students. I am so blessed to be a student as well! Thank you for all your help I can’t wait to keep learning from you.

This amazing canine trainer is Cafe and Croissant approved 🐾☕️🥐

Albert displays a great amount of patience and love for dogs. He's an amazing trainer!
Best trainer ever!!! I took my English bulldog Hemi to Connor K-9  and it was worth every penny!!!

I cannot recommend Albert and Connor Canine Training enough! I’ve been searching for someone I could truly trust with my 2-year-old Golden Retriever, Alphy, and I’m so glad I found Connor Canine Training. As a dog mom, feeling safe and comfortable leaving my fur baby in someone else’s care was a huge priority, Albert and his parents exceeded my expectations ☺️. Despite my concerns that it might be too late to start training, Albert assured me that Alphy was more than ready to learn, and he was absolutely right! My separation anxiety was eased by  frequent updates, which kept me in the loop and reassured me that Alphy was in great hands. I also appreciated how involved the training process was for me as the owner—it is so important to attend the sessions and learn alongside your dog. Thank you, Albert, for helping Alphy and me achieve such wonderful results!

If you are looking for training for your pups, Connor Canine Training is where you want to go. Boarding our two mini schnauzers, Milo and Ocean, for training was the best decision we made. Not only is Albert a fantastic dog trainer, but …

Amazing trainer and person, Not only does he get your dog in line without causing any kind of harm or stress to them but he will also make sure that you walk out of the program also knowing exactly how to keep your dog trained by showing you how it is that you need to train a dog and how to execute commands.

I want to give a special thanks to Albert for all the hard work, dedication patience and training given to our dog Luna. Our dog learned so much in 4 weeks. He is the Best in this field. We also learned some things we were doing wrong so …

I had never owned a dog before, but a few months ago, I decided to get one to keep me company and share the love I have inside. So, I decided to get a miniature schnauzer. I didn't realize how much training a dog would require, especially …
